@graph.name: Elenchon Atlas — WPS Management Software
@graph.description: Cloud WPS management software that keeps a shop's master WPS register current. It imports existing Welding Procedure Specification documents in Excel or PDF, extracts every field, and proposes human-reviewed edits that are patched — only once approved — into the shop's own workbook. Each register is versioned and exportable, with the linked WPQR and preliminary WPS (pWPS) chain kept alongside. Includes a library with structured detail and faceted search, a preview mode that compares the parse against the source document, and a heat-input helper. From Delteris — the standalone cloud WPS engine from the Elenchon platform.
@graph.keywords: WPS management software, WPS software, WPS library, WPS register, WPS document management, welding procedure specification management, WPS import, WPS parser, WPS PDF import, WPS Excel import, organize WPS, find WPS by process
featureList: Import existing WPS documents from Excel and PDF with automatic field extraction
Batch import of a whole WPS library at once
Human-reviewed change-sets — nothing is written to the register without approval
Only approved cells are patched into the shop's own workbook; the file is never rebuilt
Versioned register (v1, v2, v3...) with rollback and on-demand Excel export plus linked files
WPS library with structured detail (header fields, pass table with side and role, parts, fillers, shielding)
Automatic revision grouping and import classification (new WPS, new revision, correction)
Preview mode — parsed fields shown beside the original PDF or Excel source, with in-place edit and verify
Faceted search and filtering by process, material, position, range, side, role, link status and file type
Linked document chain per WPS — attached WPQR and pWPS, visible and printable
Heat-input helper that keeps parameters inside the PQR-qualified window
Automatic heat-input calculation on import (EN 1011-1) flagged for review
Single-tenant deployment, full audit trail, and configurable data retention
Light WPS authoring and clean Excel export (authoring on roadmap)

offers.description: €80 per month, or €720 per year (effective €60/month) billed annually. Flat, fully published price. Includes 50 GB storage; additional 50 GB blocks €10/month. One tenancy per system.
